authority: Roger 2026-10-18: E65 published repair silenced 1:10-1:14, 1:25-1:28 and 1:52-1:55 to remove wrong dialogue and left the room sound broken at those cuts.  A cut must keep one continuous room tone even when a line was removed.
active_note: Off by default (active_from_episode null) so no in-production episode changes byte-for-byte.  Opt in by setting active_from_episode, or per episode via contract assembly_audio_continuity=ASSEMBLY_AUDIO_CONTINUITY_V1.
applies_to: S7 assembly, after the selective-BGM mix and before release loudness levelling
guarantees: The dip is applied to the same single audio stream: total duration never changes and video frames are copied, so no sync risk.
The dip is a soft transition, never a mute: it lowers level at the cut point and restores it, so room tone stays continuous.
A fully silent unit is not hidden by the dip; that is a diagnostic, not something this pass may paper over.
